documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
INTIMATION FOR RESCHEDULING OF 60TH ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING OF THE COMPANY ON 26TH AUGUST 2026 (WEDNESDAY) AT 12:00 NOON (IST)

analysis.summary: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL) achieved its highest-ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT in FY26, representing 112% of its installed capacity. The company reported a gross refining margin (GRM) of $9.2 per barrel for the full year and $13.75 per barrel for Q4 FY26. CPCL recommended a final dividend of INR 54 per share, bringing the total dividend for the year to a record INR 62 per share. The company is executing major capital projects, including a Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project and a retail outlet expansion. Chennai Petroleum Corporation Ltd (CPCL) reported a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT for FY 2024-25, representing 99.5% of its installed capacity.

guidance.claim: The company expects to see significant commissioning of its retail outlets in the financial year 2026-27.
guidance.quote: Even our retail outlet endeavor for which we had taken 300 licenses has started. And this year, that is '26-'27, we'll see a lot of commissioning out of them.

guidance.claim: CPCL expects to complete an ongoing debottlenecking study in the financial year 2026-27.
guidance.quote: But in the coming year, '26-'27, we hope that ongoing study will get completed.

guidance.claim: Management expects the company's resilient operational and financial performance momentum to continue into the new financial year.
guidance.quote: To summarize, we continue to deliver resilient operational and financial performance and see the momentum to continue in the new financial year as well.

guidance.claim: The company expects throughput in 2025-26 to be higher than the previous year on the operational part.
guidance.quote: So, you can expect a throughput which is higher than last year on the operational part.

demand_outlook.claim: Global uncertainties have affected the availability of LPG worldwide.
demand_outlook.quote: With global uncertainties affecting the availability of LPG all over the world, CPCL is happy to step up the requirement when the nation needed it.

demand_outlook.claim: Cracks in recent months have remained reasonable and close to long-term averages.
demand_outlook.quote: But still in these months, the cracks are reasonable enough and close to our long-term averages.

demand_outlook.claim: There is a clear shortfall of MS in the southern market, with production being less than demand.
demand_outlook.quote: MS in southern market, there is a clear shortfall so, the production is less than demand.

demand_outlook.claim: The shortfall of MS in the southern market is close to about 20 TMT per month.
demand_outlook.quote: It is close to about 20 TMT per month.

demand_outlook.claim: The southern market is mostly aligned to the national growth projection for other products.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as others are concerned, we have seen the southern market to be mostly aligned to the national growth projection.

demand_outlook.claim: The growth forecast for HSD is seen at 3% nationally, compared to around 2.5% in the southern region.
demand_outlook.quote: HSD we see at 3% growth forecast, as against 2.5% odd here.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL's capex for the current year was INR 856 crores, up from INR 673 crores in the previous year.
capex_expansion.quote: During the current year, the capex was INR856 crores as compared to INR673 crores in the previous year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has started execution of the Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project.
capex_expansion.quote: Some of the important projects that we'll be taking up is Group 2, Group 3 LOBS for which all approvals are in place and the project execution has started in full swing.

capex_expansion.claim: The Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project is valued at INR 1,600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: LOBS project, Group 2, Group 3 LOBS project is INR1,600 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The retail outlet project is valued at INR 400 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The retail outlet project is INR400 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL expects normal maintenance capex to be around INR 500 crores annually.
capex_expansion.quote: Besides, every year, you can assume another INR500 crores is our normal capex.

capex_expansion.claim: The company spent Rs. 673 crores as CAPEX in the current year.
capex_expansion.quote: On the CAPEX front, in the current year, we have spent Rs. 673 crores as CAPEX for the current year.

capex_expansion.claim: The revised capital cost for the CBR project is Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian Oil.
capex_expansion.quote: The revised capital cost is at Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian oil respectively.

capex_expansion.claim: The normal maintenance CAPEX for the next two years is expected to be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The normal maintenance CAPEX for the next two years would be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores, maintenance CAPEX plus small regular CAPEX normally.

margins_costs.claim: The gross refining margin for FY26 was $9.2 per barrel compared to the Singapore benchmark of $5.83 per barrel.
margins_costs.quote: The gross refining margin, GRM, for financial year 2025- '26 was $9.2 per barrel as compared to Singapore benchmark of $5.83 per barrel.

margins_costs.claim: The gross refining margin for Q4 was $13.75 per barrel.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for quarter 4 was $13.75 barrel as compared to Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel, which again reiterates that all these efficiencies are constant, continuous and are being sustained over each period.

margins_costs.claim: The core GRM for the quarter was $10.3 per barrel.
Forex losses were approximately INR 200 crores for the quarter and INR 350 crores for the full year.
margins_costs.quote: For the quarter, it would be for the quarter, it is approximately INR 200 crores,. And for the whole year, it will be around INR350 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Niche products contribute around 15% of CPCL's margins.
margins_costs.quote: About 7% to 8% constitutes these kinds of niche products. And this 7%–8% is currently contributing around 15% of my margins.

margins_costs.claim: The full-year GRM for 2024-25 was $4.22 per barrel compared to $8.64 per barrel in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for 2024-25 for a full year basis is $4.22 per barrel as compared to the previous year $8.64 per barrel, but if you compare it to Singapore benchmark which was $3.79 per barrel in the current year, we have performed better.

margins_costs.claim: The GRM for Quarter 4 was $6.22 per barrel.
margins_costs.quote: On Quarter 4, our GRM was $6.22 per barrel.

margins_costs.claim: The fuel and loss has come down to 8.51% for the year as a whole.
margins_costs.quote: the fuel and loss has come down to 8.51% for the year as a whole.

margins_costs.claim: The best Energy Intensity Index figure of 87.4 was clocked in the current year, 2024-25.
margins_costs.quote: The best EII figure of 87.4 has been clocked in the current year, 2024-25.

margins_costs.claim: The operating expenditure net was reported at 1,085 Crore for 2022-23, 1,215 Crore for 2023-24, and 945 Crore for 9M 2024-25.
Total GRM was reported as 7,995 Crore in 2022-23, 6,146 Crore in 2023-24, and 1,572 Crore in 9M 2024-25.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved its highest-ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT, representing 112% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT, million metric ton, which equivalents to 112% of installed capacity, breaking records of our previous best of 11.64 MMT achieved in financial year 2023-'24.

orders_capacity.claim: Crude throughput in Q4 was 2.93 MMT, representing 111% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: In quarter 4 of the current financial year, CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 2.93 MMT, which is also 111% of installed capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved record production levels of 5.139 MMT for diesel and 1.318 MMT for petrol.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL concluded the financial year on a high note, achieving the highest ever production levels of 5.139 MMT for diesel HSD, and 1.318 MMT of petrol that is MS, an impressive testament of the refinery's outstanding operational performance.

orders_capacity.claim: LPG production reached a record 447 TMT.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved highest ever LPG production of 447 TMT, overcoming previous record of 404 set in 2023-'24.

orders_capacity.claim: Approximately 90% of CPCL's product is sold to Indian Oil.
orders_capacity.quote: No, our agreement, as you would be aware, close to about 90% of our product, mostly HSD, MS, goes to Indian Oil.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT, equivalent to 99.5% of its installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT, equivalent to 99.5% of our installed capacity and this must be seen with respect to the turnaround that has happened during the year

orders_capacity.claim: In Quarter 4, the crude throughput was 2.974 MMT, which is 113% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: coming on to Quarter 4, the crude throughput was 2.974, which is 113% of installed capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The new refinery will have a capacity of 9 million metric tons and a petrochemical intensity of 6%.
orders_capacity.quote: The new refinery capital cost is Rs 36,000 Crore approximately, 9 million metric ton capacity and petrochemical intensity of 6% and which is PP, polypropylene.

orders_capacity.claim: The Manali Refinery has an installed capacity of 10.5 MMTPA.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's debt-to-equity ratio stands at 0.18 at a gross level.
capital_allocation.quote: Our leverage position now stands at 0.18. Our debt equity stands at 0.18 at a gross level as compared to 0.39 last year.

capital_allocation.claim: Gross borrowings are INR 1,900 crores, while net borrowings are INR 973 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: On a gross basis, the borrowings are INR1,900 crores, but on a net basis, it is less than INR1,000 crores, to be precise, INR973 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of INR 54 per share, bringing the total dividend for the year to INR 62 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year, for the first time, CPCL paid an interim dividend, and we are happy to announce that in addition to the interim dividend of INR8 per equity share of INR10 each, the Board has recommended a final dividend of INR54 per share, taking the total dividend for the year to INR62 per share, which again is highest ever.

capital_allocation.claim: The debt-equity position as of March 31, 2025, is 0.39 compared to 0.32 in the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: When I turn to leverage position, the debt equity position as on March 31, 2025, is 0.39 compared to 0.32 in the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: Absolute debt stands at Rs. 3,100 crores as of March 31, 2025, compared to Rs. 2,762 crores in the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: At an absolute level, the debt stands at Rs. 3,100 crores as compared to Rs. 2,762 crores as on March 31, 2024.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board has recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share, which is 50% of the face value.
capital_allocation.quote: With the above, the Board has also recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share that is 50% of face value for the current year and as we all know, this is subject to approval at AGM, which will happen in the due course.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is working with a 2:1 debt-equity ratio for the new joint venture.
capital_allocation.quote: Presently, we are working with a 2:1 debt equity for this JV.

risks_headwinds.claim: Logistical constraints and crude oil price volatility pose challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now with all this, I would like to say the uncertainties due to logistical constraints, volatility of crude oil prices do pose challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: About 30% to 40% of Middle East cargo agreements were affected over a short period.
risks_headwinds.quote: What has impacted is that maybe 30% to 40% was affected over a very short period, but all have assured us that depending on the situation, they will make up all the cargoes.

risks_headwinds.claim: Significant rupee movement during the quarter and year impacted other expenses.
risks_headwinds.quote: As we talk because the rupee movement is significant during the quarter as well as year, that is what is accounting significantly.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volatility of crude prices poses a challenge for the company.
risks_headwinds.quote: Finally, the uncertainties due to volatility of crude prices do pose a challenge.

risks_headwinds.claim: Every $1-$2 change in crack impacts the profit because of constant operating costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Every month it is changing drastically. And every $1-$2 of crack impacts the profit because there is a constant operating cost.

risks_headwinds.claim: Large maintenance and inspection shutdowns affect product processing availability and profitability.
risks_headwinds.quote: If there are large M&I shutdown that much of product processing availability is under maintenance, that affects profitability.

risks_headwinds.claim: Exchange variation loss was 523 Crore in 2022-23, 72 Crore in 2023-24, and 122 Crore in 9M 2024-25.
CST under recovery was 463 Crore in 2022-23, 361 Crore in 2023-24, and 246 Crore in 9M 2024-25.

management_commitments.claim: CPCL expects to see significant commissioning of its retail outlets in the financial year 2026-27.
management_commitments.quote: Even our retail outlet endeavor for which we had taken 300 licenses has started. And this year, that is '26-'27, we'll see a lot of commissioning out of them.

management_commitments.claim: CPCL expects to complete its ongoing debottlenecking study in the financial year 2026-27.
management_commitments.quote: But in the coming year, '26-'27, we hope that ongoing study will get completed.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the INR 2,000 crores capex for LOBS and retail outlet projects to be spent over two to three years.
management_commitments.quote: This INR2,000 crores will happen over 2 to 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: The normal maintenance CAPEX for the next two years is expected to be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores.
management_commitments.quote: The normal maintenance CAPEX for the next two years would be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores, maintenance CAPEX plus small regular CAPEX normally.

management_commitments.claim: In the financial year 2025-26, one of the other crude units will go for maintenance along with the lubes block.
management_commitments.quote: In the current financial year 2025-26, one of the other crude units will go for maintenance along with the lubes block as such.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
